conversion_pathway.process: Riboflavin kinase (RFK) phosphorylates riboflavin to FMN using ATP.

evidence.statement: Human RFK catalyses riboflavin phosphorylation; UniProt Q969G6 entry 195 retrieved 2026-10-26, Rhea 14357.

conversion_pathway.limitations: FAD production and enzyme loading depend on cellular context; no fixed food-to-FAD yield is inferred.

functional_dependency.statement: The liver can convert tryptophan to nicotinamide, which other cells salvage into NAD⁺.

dietary_supply.statement: The liver can convert tryptophan to nicotinamide, which other cells salvage into NAD⁺.

conversion_pathway.process: Multistep hepatic kynurenine/de-novo NAD metabolism and subsequent nicotinamide availability for salvage; not a direct one-step tryptophan-to-nicotinamide reaction.
conversion_pathway.limitations: Most cells outside the liver do not run the full route. The review does not establish what share of the NAD⁺ pool comes from tryptophan, and eating more protein is not shown to raise NAD⁺. This is a review of pathways, not a human feeding trial. It does not measure how much an ordinary meal changes NAD⁺, and it does not test attention or cognitive energy. Nicotinamide riboside and nicotinamide mononucleotide, as supplement doses, are outside this dietary assessment.

admissions.biological_role: SAM provides the methyl group used to convert guanidinoacetate to creatine through guanidinoacetate methyltransferase.

admissions.operation: Enable rapid ATP buffering so high-energy-demand tissues can meet sudden metabolic spikes.

scientific_assessment.operation: Enable rapid ATP buffering so high-energy-demand tissues can meet sudden metabolic spikes.

functional_dependency.statement: Dietary methionine supplies SAM through MAT-dependent activation, sustaining methyl-donor capacity for GAMT methylation of guanidinoacetate.

dietary_supply.statement: Canonical methionine food composition provides the same amino acid used by MAT; no food-dose equivalence to experimental diets is inferred.

conversion_pathway.process: MAT1A/MAT2A catalyse ATP-dependent methionine adenosylation to form SAM.
conversion_pathway.limitations: Reaction identity establishes capacity, not a universal limiting intake or greater flux from additional intake.

evidence.statement: Human MAT crystallography and curated Rhea 21080; P31153 v237 and Q00266 v233.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Endogenous remethylation also supplies methionine. Neonatal-piglet isotope incorporation does not establish an adult intake target, cerebral delivery or benefit above adequacy. Methyl allocation, SAH inhibition, transport and other substrate availability constrain the route; no shared KC admission follows.

dietary_supply.statement: The primary experiment used an orally administered tricaprylin-rich preparation. The MCT Oil record has a product/preparation-dependent caprylic-triglyceride relationship; fatty-acid content alone is not proof of trioctanoin content.

conversion_pathway.process: Digestive lipolysis releases C8 fatty acid from trioctanoin; the absorbed fatty acid is represented as octanoate at physiological pH.
conversion_pathway.limitations: The C8 acyl form is not free octanoate content in food. Mixed-chain MCT products have formulation-dependent composition.

evidence.statement: Human triglyceride-lipase reaction provenance and the defined oral tricaprylin exposure; retrieved 26 October 2026.

conversion_pathway.process: Hepatic fatty-acid activation and successive mitochondrial beta-oxidation reactions generate acetyl-CoA from the C8 chain.
conversion_pathway.limitations: This is a multireaction biological process, not a single chemical reaction. Tissue partitioning and energy state prevent a fixed food-to-acetyl-CoA yield. Cofactor participation creates no separate dietary admissions.

evidence.statement: Human medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase establishes the initial beta-oxidation reaction; the clinical exposure additionally measures downstream ketone provision.

conversion_pathway.process: Hepatic mitochondrial ketogenesis proceeds through acetoacetyl-CoA formation, HMG-CoA synthase and HMG-CoA lyase to produce acetoacetate.
dependencies: Ketone release, circulation and brain monocarboxylate transport
conversion_pathway.limitations: The endogenous product can interconvert with beta-hydroxybutyrate, but the target identity here is acetoacetate. Ketogenesis, cerebral uptake and ATP production are distinct; no fixed yield or universal benefit is inferred.

evidence.statement: Curated human ACAT1, HMGCS2 and HMGCL reactions, retrieved 26 October 2026.

admissions.biological_role: Defined dietary caprylic triglyceride can supply hepatic ketone production and cerebral ketone-fuel availability for this ketone-utilisation operation.
admissions.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-26 mission-specific dietary recovery: admitted under the existing Type A gate; food composition does not establish an effective intervention dose.
admissions.limitation: Uncontrolled sequential exposure: C8/C10 mixture (n=11) then 95% tricaprylin (n=6), 30 g/day for one month each. No claim of isolated C8 superiority, cognitive efficacy, healthy-person requirement or ordinary coconut-oil equivalence. PET uptake/metabolism is not a direct cellular ATP assay; no food-effective dose or fixed conversion yield is inferred.
